mentions.name: VT Code
mentions.description: VT Code is a Rust-based terminal coding agent with semantic code intelligence via Tree-sitter. It supports multiple LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, xAI, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Z.AI, Moonshot AI, MiniMax, and Ollama local & Cloud) with automatic failover and efficient context management, and fully supports the Agent Client Protocol and Model Context Protocol. Preferences are stored in vtcode.toml, and Visual Studio Code and Open VSX extensions are available for install in VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf, and Eclipse.

mentions.name: VT Code
mentions.description: A Rust-based terminal coding agent that provides semantic code intelligence via Tree-sitter parsers (Rust, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go, Java) and ast-grep for structural pattern matching and refactoring. It supports multiple LLM providers — OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI, DeepSeek, Gemini, OpenRouter, Z.AI, Moonshot AI — with automatic failover, prompt caching, and token-efficient context management, configured entirely through vtcode.toml. It is a fully compatible Agent Client Protocol (ACP) agent that works with any ACP client, with first-class support for Zed plus Neovim and marimo notebook integration.
